kernel.what: The kernel lane of the cryptids audit: google-deepmind/cryptids at its pin built with its own toolchain and audited by leanprover/comparator with nanoda on, using the configurations the repository ships. A CERTIFIED row is a concordance with the repository's own CI (the stated theorems are the ones proved, the axioms are as printed, a second kernel accepts the proofs); it verifies no mathematics. Written by tools/record-cryptids-kernel.js from the workflow's artifacts.
